content.description: Iteration 2 from best it01 spec s00: faster discharge (tau/minGap/accel), stronger early start and red running, more sidewalk seekers, longer box hold.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car sim 0.74 s vs obs 0.35 s and M5/length 48.6 m vs 15.8 m (long queues, M6 l/u approach 180-280 s vs 50-63 s): tau 0.45, minGap 1.0 and accel 3.6 shorten the discharge headway so queues clear within the green.
Cars that may use the right-turn lane (M9a sim 1.0 vs 0.57 veh/cycle); same fast discharge as car_normal for M1/car, and the right_lane probability is cut to lower M9a.
M1/moto sim 0.49 s vs 0.30 s: tau 0.4, minGap 0.5 and accel 6 shorten headway; impatience 0.5 targets M4/overshoot_share (sim 0 vs 0.62) by letting riders pass the stop line more readily.
Slow riders (speedFactor 0.7) keep M6/approach/s/moto close (37.8 vs 35.7 s); tau 0.5 and minGap 0.6 also lower M1/moto toward 0.30 s.
M10a sidewalk riders sim 0.11 vs 0.56 veh/cycle: raise the seeker share from 0.18 to 0.30 so more riders can take the sidewalk; shorter tau/minGap for M1/moto; impatience 0.5 for M4/overshoot.

M7a/n_waiting 1.4 vs 5.6 veh and M6/junction/illegal_l 23 vs 36.8 s: a larger jmTimegapMinor 1.3 and impatience 0.7 (was 0.8 and 1.0) make riders accept fewer gaps and wait in the box instead of crossing early.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto sim 0.017 vs 0.13 and M2/first_delay 0.69 vs 2.83 s, M4/overshoot_share 0: p raised from 0.15 to 0.5 and window to 10 s so more front-row riders creep over the line before green.
M2/early/car sim 0 vs 0.011: p from 0.02 to 0.08, since few draws execute.

M3/share/moto sim 0.007 vs 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 0.29 vs 3.9: only about 8% of draws ran at p0 0.06 and few vehicles are at the line, so p0 is raised to 0.5; k stays small to keep M3/var_to_mean near 1.1.
M3/share/car sim 0 vs 0.004: p0 0.004 gave no runner, so 0.05 with no swarm effect gives a rare event.

p_wrong_lane is inapplicable (sim 0, redistributed) so it is set to 0; p_right_lane 0.02 matches F2/right_lane 0.02 and lowers M9a (1.0 vs 0.57); p_sidewalk 0.3 targets M10a (0.11 vs 0.56 veh/cycle); q 8 m triggers earlier now that queues should be shorter (M10b/M9c 15 m).
M7a/release_time sim -5.3 vs +2.8 s and M7b/clear_lag 3.9 vs 5.5 s: release_lag_s from 1.0 to 3.5 moves box exit later, after the opposing green end.
Unchanged: slow riders in the lane centre (behaviour 10), M6/approach/s/moto already near target.

reasoning: Starting from the best it01 spec (s00, S 0.997), I shortened tau/minGap and raised accel for cars and motorcycles because M1 headways (0.74/0.49 s vs 0.35/0.30 s) and queues (M5 48.6 vs 15.8 m, M6 l/u approach times) were far too long. I raised early_start p (0.15 to 0.5) and swarm p0 (0.06 to 0.5) because M2/M3/M4 moto shares were 5-15 times too low, and added impatience 0.5 on motos for stop-line overshoot. I set p_wrong_lane 0 (sim 0, inapplicable), lowered p_right_lane (M9a too high), raised p_sidewalk and moto_seeker share (M10a 0.11 vs 0.56). I lengthened release_lag_s to 3.5 and raised jmTimegapMinor for illegal-left riders because M7a release_time was negative and n_waiting too low.
